name: AR_RECON_SUMMARY_PARAMETERS
description: This table stores the parameters input by the user for executing the Data Extraction Program.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: RECON_SUMMARY_PARAM_ID
columns.description: Surrogate key as there is no natural primary key.

columns.name: REQUEST_NAME
columns.description: The logical name entered by the user for the request.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger Identification for which extract is run

columns.name: BU_ID
columns.description: Business Unit Id entered by the user.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Name of the Period for which data is extracted

columns.name: PERIOD_START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the period entered by the user

columns.name: PERIOD_END_DATE
columns.description: End date of the period entered by the user

columns.name: INCLUDE_ON_ACCOUNT_ITEM
columns.description: Stores the value the parameter on account item entered by the user

columns.name: INCLUDE_INTERCOMPANY_TRX
columns.description: Stores the value the parameter 'Include Intercompany Transaction' entered by the user

columns.name: INCLUDE_UNAPP_UNID_RECEIPTS
columns.description: Stores the value the parameter 'Include Unapplied Receipt and Unidentified Cash' entered by the user

columns.name: BALANCING_SEGMENT_FROM
columns.description: Stores the 'From' of the range of Balancing segment entered by the user

columns.name: BALANCING_SEGMENT_TO
columns.description: Stores the 'To' of the range of Balancing segment entered by the user

columns.name: COST_CENTRE_SEGMENT_FROM
columns.description: Stores the From value of the cost center segment entered by the user.

columns.name: COST_CENTRE_SEGMENT_TO
columns.description: Stores the To value of the cost center segment entered by the user.

columns.name: NATURAL_ACCOUNT_SEGMENT_FROM
columns.description: Stores the 'From' of the range of Natural Account segment entered by the user

columns.name: NATURAL_ACCOUNT_SEGMENT_TO
columns.description: Stores the 'To' of the range of Natural Account segment entered by the user

columns.name: INTERCOMPANY_SEGMENT_FROM
columns.description: Stores the 'From' of the range of Intercompany segment entered by the user

columns.name: INTERCOMPANY_SEGMENT_TO
columns.description: Stores the 'To' of the range of Intercompany segment entered by the user

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.
